items.title: What Does Duke Energy (DUK) Winning Carolinas Plan Approval Mean For Investors?
items.summary: Duke Energy (NYSE:DUK) secured North Carolina Utilities Commission approval of its 2025 Carolinas Resource Plan and related rate plan. The approved roadmap outlines new investments in solar, battery storage, natural gas and nuclear to meet rising electricity demand in the Carolinas. Regulators backed updated tariffs for data center customers alongside expanded consumer protections and cost focused rate structures for households.
